title: Audit retimed native packet conservation, historical owner backing and the actual stopping control
body:
## Source-bound storage and control audit; no new κ

This answers two concrete parts of the #8042 independent-review handoff: the nonidentity packet crossing and the actual capped stopping predicate. It consolidates the packet/owner investigation with a separately authored stopping-control appendix and a kernel-checked Lean proof of the actual capped-power predicate. The accepted selected certificate and all five foundational assumptions remain unchanged.

Base: `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. Audited source: Ali Romman's #8042 at `dfd25d553a843a946ca0b94130a5ff8943e98fdd`. Initial publication head: `61eef3f8aef8c40a952af08a0d518cdb3ee0b9f0`. Package: `research/retimed-packet-storage-audit`.

## Exact result and why it matters

The proof binds the real caller to an owner volume `V=W/B`, a covered packet volume `ell=V/Q`, and the conservation identity `(pending-p0)+(answers-a0)+ell=V` at every ordered same-stage edge. All high representatives, older coordinates, both coarse blocks, gaps and suffixes remain present. Both nonidentity basis routes and the entrance/exit full-cohort traversals are charged. A source-specific suffix-return induction explains arbitrary depth and historical address reuse, including previously longer siblings.

The correct lifetime fence is narrower than “no scratch survives”: named pages, owner banks, stage-root files and different-stage ancestors remain live. Newly opened rank-local transient spools close before the next same-stage paid edge. The audit records this distinction explicitly.

For positive owner arenas, a child starts after the parent's historical slot high. A minimal two-slot example disproves using the current live count: retiring the first slot leaves the second live, so a child beginning at `live*extent` overwrites it. The unchanged source correctly uses `high*extent`. Changing child-window widths and live zero owners are also checked.

The stopping appendix binds `D=10^21` to the source predicate: 70 exponent bits, at most 69 squares and 29 selected products. Its independent serial-bit lowering includes restoration and clearing. The comparison-width charge uses the genuine parent's failed test; an arbitrary large root header with a small unrelated child does not satisfy that theorem. Existing abstract inequalities in #8042's `OuterStop.lean` retain their credit.

### Consolidated Lean supplement

`formal/CappedPower.lean` proves the cap-at-`h+1` threshold equivalence, termination by exponent halving, the source low-bit branch, the omitted final square, and the actual wrapper/caller theorem. The negated caller yields the strict failed-parent relation used by `STOPPING.md`. The proof SHA256 is `ee9ec96c4f92b2a45f6d2998db0383b43e4051b32131be09ff1c3a36d3b1bec2`.

Author and root Lean 4.36.0 replays and a fresh offline publication-wrapper replay passed. All fifteen axiom reports use only the declared standard Lean axioms `propext`, `Quot.sound` and, for the bitwise theorem, `Classical.choice`. There is no `sorry`, `admit`, new axiom or native decision oracle. Exact hash/AST checks bind the theorem to the pinned Python function and its parameter forwarding; Python operational semantics, tape time and the 98-product cost argument are not formalized. The predecessor `OuterStop.lean` is retained unchanged and keeps priority for its abstract volume inequalities.

## Independent evidence and failure controls

| Fixture | Opaque records | Same-stage calls | Earlier-stage calls |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Nonidentity direct route, modulus 9 | 52,488 | 1 | 10 |
| Covered dirty spectators, modulus 3 | 10,368 | 40 | 80 |
| All 16 lows and 27 true highs, modulus 9 | 2,834,352 | 40 | 80 |

A separate matrix-action oracle checks every output record, external guard and final cursor. The complete registered offline replay passed in the author and root publication worktrees. Five mutations of actual packet/source function bodies reject a missing inverse route, omitted high representatives, lost answer marker, dirty retired tail and a transient spool spanning a paid call. The sixth owner mutation rejects the live-count child base.

The stopping checker covers 5,460 serial products, 74,496 cases against an independent repeated-multiplication oracle, 371 lowered comparisons and 2,240 genuine-child relations. Its controls expose capping at `h` instead of `h+1`, mishandled equality and omission of the parent premise.

Each packet fixture has **one genuine weighted-child depth**; the 40 calls are siblings. The all-depth argument uses the actual caller equations and suffix induction, not extrapolation from those tests. Low/high enumeration itself is inherited; the payload-action oracle is independent.

## Reproduce and publication integrity

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/retimed-packet-storage-audit
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/retimed-packet-storage-audit --check-modes
```

Expected markers: `PASS_RETIMED_STORAGE_AND_STOPPING_AUDIT`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`, and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. Python 3.12, standard library plus Git; the full registered command has a 600-second bound. The original complete packet replay passed in both author and root publication worktrees; that scientific engine is unchanged. The follow-up adds the unchanged predecessor `OuterStop.lean` to the authenticated inventory (26 source files, versus 25 in the original receipts), validates metadata/source bindings, and replays the formal supplement separately:

```sh
python3 -B research/retimed-packet-storage-audit/formal/replay.py \
  --lean /absolute/path/to/lean --output /tmp/retimed-capped-power-review
```

This requires an already installed Lean 4.36.0 binary; no installation, network or Mathlib is used. Expected additional marker: `PASS_CAPPED_POWER_KERNEL_AND_SOURCE_BINDING`. The Python-only registered runner does not silently claim a Lean check. The 59-file package at the publication head has exactly the reviewed local tree; no pre-existing canonical files are changed. The exact remote commit passed the committed-byte/mode gate.

Hosted CI success is not claimed. The initial run failed in unchanged base onboarding: `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record` expects `make frontier7000-verify`, but `docs/ci.md` still names #6030. That failure occurred before research package selection/replay; the local registered replay passed. This contribution does not modify shared CI guidance.

## Scope, overlap and remaining obligations

Task `uniform-transfer-audit`, changed scope: the current #8042 caller handoff replaces the catalogue's older selected-source pointer. This supplies enabling storage/control evidence, not complete assumption removal. #8042 already contains the abstract historical theorem; this contribution supplies actual nonidentity caller binding, an independent payload oracle and semantic failure controls. #8057 inherits this storage source. #8048 uses an older installation, so its open inventory question is not transferred here. No related open @CubeJerry PR was found for this handoff.

The production simultaneous-owner/local-adapter census, all-size header encoding, full movement tariff, complete seven-stage outer clock and analytic recovery remain separate obligations. The package does not execute astronomical production ranks or establish a new global space constant, threshold, κ or unconditional multiplier. `TASK.json` records concrete next questions; the first is the actual live-owner census at production yields.

## Credit

Ali Romman supplied the retimed runtime, original storage and stopping arguments, and formal component lemmas. Clear1nsight's inventory question and the retained predecessor lineage are credited without conflating their source pins. Original source bytes and licenses are retained. Prepared for Jerry Chen / @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance and separate model-assisted review; this is not human peer review or kernel verification of the complete multiplication theorem.


## Reviewed owner and local-byte completion — 2026-11-23

Published follow-up: `5b9a3d018f74c835ef87db86ce824d8026257b6b`. The same PR now includes the recovered `census/` and `bytes/` appendices, their separate reviews and a portable registered supplement runner. The frozen original proof, source inputs and formal supplement remain unchanged.

The Gaussian owner census proves `Arena.live <= B + 115058 sum_e count[e](Q delay[e]+1)` at the actual allocation/lifetime interface. Its production `<2B` consequence retains the source mass and delay bounds; it is not a proof of the binary owner premise. The local byte results are wide-owner route `<8V`, padded-type route `<9V`, and production repair `<=8V`. The old L=17 example only refuted intermediate tag/payload inequalities: its total is 7V. A corrected symbolic L=33 example has total 9V and rejects the unrestricted generic 8V claim; no 2^33-record execution is claimed.

The complete registered packet/storage replay passed again, including the 2,834,352-record full fixture, followed by all four owner/byte author and separate-review methods. Committed-file bytes and executable modes passed the publication gate. The source mutations, historical maxima and dirty-return controls remain active. Hosted planning/check status is separate from these local results.

These are scoped source proofs. Full ordinary-stack composition, the remaining local work-file bounds, binary mass/stock, headers/private control, complete tape movement and analytic recovery are separate obligations. No selected assumption, frontier value or activation threshold is changed. Prepared for Jerry Chen / @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance and separate model-assisted review.


## Consolidated follow-up: historical role bounds and certified production mass

Published head `de02b59fa9a74d4958d0d114d25e9083ab91b022` has tree `e616016a578dab1320ca1c3bd9544a54909c064b`, identical to the locally verified complete tree. It preserves all 150 nonmetadata files from `5b9a3d018f74c835ef87db86ce824d8026257b6b`, including the entire landed census and byte subtrees. There are 86 additions, three metadata/documentation modifications, and no deletions; the combined package contains 239 files.

[Repair proof](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/de02b59fa9a74d4958d0d114d25e9083ab91b022/research/retimed-packet-storage-audit/repair-bounds/PROOF.md) · [Direct scalar/root proof](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/de02b59fa9a74d4958d0d114d25e9083ab91b022/research/retimed-packet-storage-audit/direct-scale/PROOF.md) · [Mass enclosure proof](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/de02b59fa9a74d4958d0d114d25e9083ab91b022/research/retimed-packet-storage-audit/mass-enclosure/PROOF.md) · [Separate mass review](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/de02b59fa9a74d4958d0d114d25e9083ab91b022/research/retimed-packet-storage-audit/mass-enclosure/review/CROSS-REVIEW.md)

### What the follow-up proves

Historical storage is the sum of each fixed role's maximum over the call history. The repair supplement establishes the production bound `<=6V*` across differing calls, using the literal header premise `t<=a/2`. The weaker `t<=a` gives six volumes per invocation but can reach seven after role-wise maxima; an executed all-bad/all-good control demonstrates the distinction. The correction key is proved a permutation before final validation, and zero radix bits are treated separately. The generic 17-bit example totals seven volumes; the 33-bit nine-volume example remains symbolic and unexecuted.

For all admitted scalar factors and positive component widths, the 22 fixed scalar roles occupy at most `(27521/3420)V*<9V*`; the five ordinary-root roles use `<7V*`, and the serial public binary rectangle uses `<18V_slab`, independent of its prefix count. An actual differing-factor sequence reaches `650/81` volumes. The scalar author uses complete residue periods; the independent reviewer uses a different finite-prefix and analytic-tail proof. Named pages, owner banks, child service scratch and earlier-stage ancestors retain their separate bills.

The literal `Measure.inverse_power` recurrence is now bounded for dyadic `t=k/2^d`: with `g=2^p`, `1<=x<=X`, each endpoint error is at most `E_d(X)/g`, where `E_d(X)=(d+1)(d+2)X/2+d+1`. Each mass endpoint has error at most `2V E_d(X)/(t g)`. This handles zero rounded lower endpoints, the actual source bit order, and empty intervals. The authenticated production grades and constructor expressions yield `d<=60`, `t>=1/2`, `V=N^6`, `g>N^64` and nonempty endpoints at most `2064N`, hence `Delta<2^24 N^-57<=2^-33<1/4`.

Consequently each bin-count excess is less than `5/4<2`. The [owner corollary](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/de02b59fa9a74d4958d0d114d25e9083ab91b022/research/retimed-packet-storage-audit/mass-enclosure/OWNER-COROLLARY.md) composes this with the existing census and delay bound to derive the local numerical premise of `Arena.high<2B`. It retains the other successful-call, custody, schedule, funding and allocation contracts. This is not a discharge of the complete analytic-recovery or owned-erasure assumption.

### Verification and exact scope

The unchanged landed owner and byte replay passed again. The new offline replay passed the repair, direct author/reviewer, mass author, independent numerical review and literal production-binding checks. The independent mass reviewer uses rational log/exp series and integer-root bisection without importing the author's scientific checker. Its 600 inverse-power, 1,080 mass and 1,320 allocation cases include four rejected source mutations. Frozen numerical and production receipts reproduce exactly; adapters retain assertions even under an optimized parent process. The canonical metadata/source-pin validator and 239-file committed-byte/mode comparison passed locally against the published tree.

`python3 -IB research/retimed-packet-storage-audit/verify_followups.py --output /tmp/retimed-repair-direct-mass-followups` yields `PASS_RETIMED_REPAIR_DIRECT_AND_MASS_FOLLOWUPS`. The combined registration retains the earlier packet/stopping engine and has budgets 600, 420 and 180 seconds. The original authenticated graph loader reconstructs its large graph temporarily. No production-size calendar or complete production child is executed by these finite checks; universal claims rest on the written arguments.

The complete ordinary/outer storage census, private controls, complete tape movement and activation threshold remain separate. The selected κ and all five canonical assumptions are unchanged. Credit Ali Romman's runtime and storage architecture, the retained source authors and independent reviewers. Prepared for Jerry Chen / @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance and separate model-assisted review; external human or proof-kernel acceptance remains open.

## Completed ordinary data-file join and derived binary capacity — 2026-11-23

The current head is `b500f72bbcf9c03a7f7fd40b366eedd6d1dd285b`, tree `02ba12cfeaa324b9b002806f0bbcb3103e3a5808`. It preserves the earlier owner, byte, mass, repair and direct-scalar results, adds the independently reviewed ordinary composition and local table, and derives the binary capacity antecedent needed by their joined theorem. This is the current status of those local subproblems; earlier open-item wording and frozen handoffs are historical. The full physical and outer obligations remain explicit.

[Joined storage theorem](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b500f72bbcf9c03a7f7fd40b366eedd6d1dd285b/research/retimed-packet-storage-audit/JOINED-STORAGE.md) · [Binary census](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b500f72bbcf9c03a7f7fd40b366eedd6d1dd285b/research/retimed-packet-storage-audit/binary-census/PROOF.md) · [Production corollary](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b500f72bbcf9c03a7f7fd40b366eedd6d1dd285b/research/retimed-packet-storage-audit/binary-census/COROLLARY.md) · [Independent application review](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b500f72bbcf9c03a7f7fd40b366eedd6d1dd285b/research/retimed-packet-storage-audit/binary-application-review/APPLICATION-REVIEW.md)

### Ordinary local, ancestor and warm-history bound

The 20 named ancestor heads give `G(B,beta)=((beta+4)B+75/8)/(B-1)`. The actual same-stage child has volume at most W/B: direct children receive W/B, while covered children receive W/(BQ). Earlier-stage children are treated at the strict predecessor stage. A temporary scratch coefficient does not enlarge the child's mathematical width. The complete 67-position local census gives `A(B)<=17+54/B`. Together with the eight-unit root term, substitution at beta=2 gives `31+r(B)`, where `r(B)=123/(8(B-1))+54/B`. At B>=32768 the exact inequality `254r(B)<1` closes the at-most-seven-stage recurrence.

At the frozen source's definitions of T and X, the resulting ordinary data-file bound is `H_native<8261T<74349X`. Across the specified fixed installation and fixed physical roles, the six separate public binary roles contribute at most `3X_max`, giving `H_history<74352X_max` from an empty reservation. Existing reservations receive their per-role maximum grant. A later small call or erasure does not shrink the historical capacity left by an earlier large call. The proof retains the actual source-length condition used for the tag bound, rather than extending the production estimate to invalid tiny bodies. The generic history method from #5286/#5404 is credited.

### Binary numerical capacity is now derived

For the pinned binary source, P=18,906 prepared targets and q=104,904 paid labels give the inclusive owner census `capacity <= B + 22339 C*`, with `C*=sum_e count[e]*(q*delay[e]+1)` and `22339=P+3433`. The 3,433 private-owner maximum occurs during closing cleanup. Counting paid boundaries alone sees only 2,803 and would undercharge the live state; opening and closing lifetimes are included. Suspended child loans, closing order and the allocator's one-operation transition invariant are treated explicitly.

The separate production argument combines the accepted literal mass enclosure and delay bound to prove `C*<2N^83`; with `B=Recipe.width=N^92`, the census gives `capacity<2B` at the stated production heights. The actual installed calls satisfy those height conditions. The application review checks that this B is the same owner count and width used by the ordinary theorem and that each field has the charged W/B extent. Thus the former binary beta=2 numerical antecedent is supplied under the stated successful-call, lifetime and custody hypotheses. It is distinct from the earlier Gaussian capacity result and from warm physical backing.

### Verification and retained scope

Separate author/reviewer roles covered the ordinary composition, local census, joined substitution, binary owner census, capacity corollary and final caller application. Reviewers use their own interpreters and exact arithmetic. Normal and optimized checks agree, with controls for invalid tiny source bodies, omitted closing-tail owners, carry/order mistakes and historical reservations. Universal conclusions rest on written source-bound proofs; the finite checks corroborate them.

The complete four-command registered replay passed with budgets 420, 300, 180 and 300 seconds. Its fourth command now runs `verify_storage_completion.py`, combining ordinary and binary checks and ending with `PASS_RETIMED_COMPLETE_ORDINARY_AND_BINARY_STORAGE`. Fresh receipts are written outside the package, and the runner checks that package files remain unchanged. The 374-file committed-byte/mode gate passed. All 47 binary integration files and the three separate application-review files retain their frozen hashes. Parent status prose was corrected after review without changing the scientific files or verification commands.

These are ordinary data-file extents. Borrowed backing, header/private-control encoding, delimiters, complete tape movement, outer Gaussian/CRT allocations and application of the retained analytic recovery framework remain separate. The selected κ and all five canonical assumptions are unchanged. The binary result retains legal-call, custody and source return/erasure hypotheses; it does not discharge the complete owned-erasure or precision/tape contract. No production-sized multiplier execution, external human acceptance, new kernel proof or hosted-CI success is claimed. Source notices and earlier attribution are preserved.


## Reviewed decoder control representation and historical allowance

At the pinned #8042 binary caller, h>=3000, N=2^h and B=N^92, the represented rows, live and pending tables, ordered zero lists, suspended leaf continuations, immutable event tape and chart dictionary occupy less than **32 B N h bits**. Since W/B>=9^N, this is less than W bytes. The conditional additional same-stage history is below 2W and the seven-stage allowance is below 4,572 X_max bytes, retaining previous per-role maxima. These allowances cover fixed decoder roles, not the resident native bodies.

The codec preserves each typed Axis(basis, column), ordered masks and complete Job interface. All 104,904 paid labels reduce to 595 exact signed rational base words of maximum length 61; the charged library is 215,644 bytes. Source-bound lifts establish the arbitrary-width closure.

The author replay covers 7,443 chart lifts, 29,772 ordered selections, every paid incidence and 432 state images with 2,208 suspended leaf roundtrips. A separate implementation reconstructs 2,463 dense endpoints, all paid labels, 7,443 lifts, 792 event roundtrips and 4,368 callbacks, with 14 failure controls. It imports none of the author codec, checker or loader. All 17 retained sources were independently compared with their exact commit:path bytes. Both registered author and independent replays passed in normal and optimized Python with private fresh caches. The 43-file committed-byte/mode gate passed. Universal claims rest on the written proofs, not extrapolation from these tests.

Native iterator registers, restoration lists, caches, native frames and dispatch remain charged external services. Setup, fixed-tape movement, complete receiver/outer headers and analytic recovery remain separate. Python RAM use and generator restart are not proved. No new κ, activation threshold, complete assumption discharge or hosted-CI acceptance is claimed. ## Reviewed native restoration-list storage at fixed production height

Head `8a552b64f150585908acb8c8fb21d6ec41cd8706`, tree `42cd31894bf5bafc0a6810279c2310a70d7d1ad8`, adds 49 files in `research/retimed-native-restoration` and preserves every earlier file. This supplies one native value-class bound that both decoder packages deliberately excluded.

The actual `StrongBinarySource.raw` saves one ordered matcher for each of P=18,906 productive entries and retains that list through paid suspensions and closing. Its final routes use the saved list in reverse order with each word inverted. Source input closure and complete target closure give at most 61N operations per basis; `Frame.matcher_to` adds at most N swaps. Thus every saved matcher and inverse has at most **123N operations**. All 18,906 actual target tags, including helper start/final pairs, have 2,120 distinct requests; the maximum target base length is 52. Later private route words are outside this list and are not assigned that bound.

The exact encoding requires **six signed numerator bits and five denominator bits**. Actual difference pair (45,388), operation 39, has scale 7/20; its inverse 20/7 disproves a signed-five-bit numerator allowance. No composed dense rational coefficient is silently formed.

Four fixed tapes provide reusable segments for C=2N^83 context slots. A slot remains occupied through opening, paid calls and closing, and is cleared/released only after final return. New identifiers reuse those segments, preserving their old maxima. Including four complete list/image roles, binary symbol encoding and framing/scalar slack gives **less than 2^28 N^84 h < BNh < W bits**, for h>=3000, N=2^h, B=N^92 and the retained W/B>=9^N geometry. W here is the numerical byte count; no factor-eight saving is assumed. This is fixed-height role history, not a cross-height or whole-runtime bound.

A separate source inspection establishes that `ActiveCatalogue` overrides the old initializer and installs no per-instance cached methods. The fixed zero-argument chart cache remains separately charged. This does not bound unrelated runtime caches.

The independent reviewer imports neither author checker nor source loader. It reconstructs every ordered target, checks 4,240 literal lifts, all 595 inverse words, 1,190 bit-exact matcher/inverse encodings, and the complete original wrapper/raw/inner metadata run: 104,904 paid calls, 53,796 routes and the exact final 18,906 reverse-inverse routes. Nine controls reject field overflow, five-bit reciprocation, truncation, wrong return chronology and fresh physical allocation per context. Numerical bank payloads are abstracted; numerical restoration/custody remains inherited. The author independently covers 6,360 lifts and 3,570 matcher/inverse roundtrips. Both registered normal/optimized suites reproduce frozen receipts with private fresh caches; the 50-file committed-byte/mode gate and all 25 copied published input comparisons pass.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/retimed-native-restoration

```

Expected markers include `PASS_NATIVE_RESTORATION_AUTHOR_NORMAL_OPTIMIZED_FRESH_CACHE`, `PASS_NATIVE_RESTORATION_INDEPENDENT_NORMAL_OPTIMIZED_FRESH_CACHE` and the registered-package/committed-byte passes.

Matcher-construction arrays, caller port arrays, active dictionaries, inner registers, generator frames, other route words, allocator state, numerical bodies and service dispatch/access time remain excluded. No full native state/time theorem, canonical assumption removal, κ change, Python-memory bound or hosted-CI acceptance is claimed. The preceding head's hosted replay was skipped after unchanged baseline docs/ci.md failed the selected-record navigation test.
